name: 3DGS-MCMC
definition: Reinterprets the Gaussian cloud as samples from an underlying probability distribution and uses Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to guide the life cycle (spawn/prune) of primitives, replacing noisy positional gradient magnitude heuristics.
summary: 3DGS-MCMC replaces noisy gradient heuristics with Markov Chain Monte Carlo sampling to guide Gaussian lifecycle, yielding stable, artifact-free point clouds by exploring unknown regions via Metropolis-Hastings acceptance.
